description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Response class, which manages XMLRPC responses including setting and retrieving return values, encoding, and loading/saving XML responses. It handles fault detection and response parsing for XMLRPC communication.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Response
classes.description: Class for handling XMLRPC responses, including setting return values, encoding, loading from XML, and generating XML responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response object, optionally with a return value and type.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the response and updates the encoding for XMLRPC values.

methods.name: setReturnValue
methods.description: Sets the return value and optional type hint.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcReturn
methods.description: Gets the XMLRPC value object for the return value.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Checks if the response is a fault response.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Returns the fault object if response is a fault.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Loads and parses an XMLRPC response, detecting faults and extracting values.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Generates the XML representation of the response.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML response as a string.
